html: Setting up the first LLM-inference GPU infrastructure at HiLabs, serving fine-tuned SLMs for downstream tasks to cut token spend and speed up inference.
Graduated from IIT Roorkee and joined HiLabs as a Data Scientist.
Started Google Summer of Code 2026 with GNU Octave: rewriting the ANOVA stack as an object-oriented framework.
Joined HiLabs as a Data Science intern, building LLM-as-a-judge evaluation pipelines.
Silver at Inter-IIT Tech Meet 14.0: 1st runner-up on the ISRO geospatial VLM problem statement among 24 IITs.
Received a pre-placement offer from HiLabs after winning the HiLabs AIQuest hackathon at IIT Roorkee.
Data science internship at Info Edge.
Silver in Tech GC, IIT Roorkee, for an AI interview platform.
